experiments.title: Does More Study Time Mean Better Grades?
experiments.question: Do students who study more hours each week tend to score higher on their final exams?
experiments.summary: A first look at the relationship between weekly study hours and final scores in a small illustrative sample.
findings: Study time and final score move together in this sample: the correlation is r = 0.67.
The relationship is positive but not perfect — several high-effort points still sit below the trend line.
With only 10 observations the estimate is imprecise, so it should not be read as a precise effect size.
experiments.note: Demo dataset. These numbers illustrate the workflow, not the result of a real study.
